rea.group.help: Run the rea reverse-engineering MCP server at the pinned version, in the mode you chose.
rea.serve.help: Start the rea MCP server on stdio (the harness launches this).
rea.serve.dry_run: Print the command that would start the server, as JSON, and exit without starting it.
rea.status.help: Show the mode, the pinned version, the image and Docker availability.
rea.mode.help: Choose how rea runs: isolated (container) or direct (on this machine).
rea.error.not_installed: rea is not installed: run 'wev skills update rea' first.
rea.error.version_invalid: The pinned rea version is not a valid version string.
rea.error.cwd_refused: Isolated mode refuses to mount {cwd}: it is the root, your home or a parent of it. Run from a project directory, or use 'wev rea mode direct'.
rea.error.path_refused: Isolated mode refuses a directory whose path contains ':', ',' or a control character, or a rea home that is not absolute: Docker would read it as mount options.
rea.error.home_refused: Isolated mode refuses {path}: it is a symbolic link, and the writable mount would follow it. Remove the link.
rea.error.docker_missing: Isolated mode needs Docker, which was not found on the safe path. Install Docker, or use 'wev rea mode direct'.
rea.error.npx_missing: Direct mode needs npx, which was not found on the safe path. Install Node.js, or use 'wev rea mode isolated'.
rea.warning.direct: Direct mode runs rea on this machine with your account's permissions; it can read and write what you can. You carry the authorization and responsibility for what you analyze.
rea.warning.isolated: Isolated mode runs rea in a container: static and web-bundle analysis work, but runtime tools (Frida, adb, browser and Electron capture, debuggers) are unavailable.
